items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.

Experience developing job descriptions
Experience administering HR programs in a university setting.

Advises all levels of managers, supervisors, and employees in developing job descriptions, resolving benefits issues, and providing guidance on compensation programs, personnel policies and procedures. (30% time)

Reviews resumes and applications and interviews applicants for a full range of staff positions. Manages the recruitment process for all levels. Reviews or oversees the review of resumes and applications and participates in the applicant interview process. Serves as a strategist for successfully attracting, recruiting, and retaining top-tier talent for supported units; responsible for developing comprehensive recruitment strategies. Develops job descriptions in consultation with division/department management. (25% time)
Provides support to departments in administering policies and programs in the areas of employment, labor relations, wage and salary administration, training, and other areas of HR. (10% time)
Prioritizes work assignments, conducts complex HR trends analyses and develops resulting recommendations. (10% time)

Supports key initiatives through the development, administration and assessment of HR services and procedures including the STAR Award program and annual performance management process. Participates in work groups, committees, and attends trainings related to HR activities, leave administration, and payroll. Performs other duties as assigned. (10% time)
Counsels department managers and supervisors on employee and labor policies, procedures, and appropriate practices. (5% time)
Manages sensitive and confidential information and maintain records for equal employment opportunity and affirmative action reporting requirements. (5% time)

Assists with the bi-weekly and monthly payroll process which may require auditing, reporting, and escalating complex payroll issues to campus partners, as appropriate. Works collaboratively with the Assistant Director and serves as a timekeeping system administrator for Facilities Services. May provide troubleshooting and training support to supervisors and other administrators in the unit. (5% time)

Possesses strong analytical skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations, demonstrating organization and problem-solving skills.
Has thorough knowledge of organizational policies and procedures; knowledge of functional area and understands how work may impact other areas.
Has thorough knowledge of human resources concepts, policies and procedures, employment practices, labor relations, salary administration, training and other areas of human resources.
Knows the university's Human Resources Management System (HRMS) and other related business software programs and systems.
Is skilled in communicating clearly and effectively verbally and in writing.
Demonstrates skill in prioritizing competing work assignments, employing political acumen and integrating information to determine appropriate courses of action and their implications.
Possesses strong analytical, active listening and critical thinking skills.
Demonstrated ability to handle very difficult or volatile situations/individuals effectively.
Ability to organize work, establish priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to independently gather and analyze data, performing sound judgment and decision making.
Ability to extract data from systems and the ability to analyze, validate and prepare consolidated reports using tools such as pivot tables and formulas within Microsoft Excel.
